news.title: OpenAI proposed donating 5% of its equity to a US sovereign wealth fund
news.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has reportedly proposed giving 5% of the company’s equity to a U.S. sovereign wealth fund, reviving discussions about letting the public share in the financial gains from the AI

news.title: Microsoft launches its own AI deployment company with $2.5 billion commitment

news.title: Wonka Netflix show faces backlash for AI-generated Gene Wilder voice
news.description: The actor, who died in 2016, appears in the Netflix show with the consent of his estate.

news.title: Can Cursor Remain a Platform for OpenAI and Anthropic’s Models Inside SpaceX?
news.description: Cursor hopes to continue offering third-party AI models after it's acquired by SpaceX, testing the relationships between frontier AI labs.

news.title: You Can Now Sound the Alarm on AI Behaving Badly

news.title: New attack provides one more reason why AI browsers are a bad idea
news.description: Telling an LLM that 2 + 2 = 5 is enough to make it follow forbidden instructions.
